confidence: Moderate on method, low on culprit. Poison was in the individual glass, with an apparent unattended interval and later service custody.
plausibility_notes: Shared punch and food testing makes individual vessel poisoning a coherent inference.
Leaving donor glass unattended while an argument starts is plausible amid event disruption.
Photographic captions should not be treated as exhaustive continuous surveillance; manager testimony remains a statement.
The service-manager title leaves some ambiguity over whether this is Brie personally or a separate worker.
Precise minute stamps are useful game clues but feel assembled for investigation more than a normal catering diary.
